newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex outlines Oct. Mexico crude export prices.
newsitem.headline: Pemex outlines Oct. Mexico crude export prices.

text.p: Mexico's prices on exported crude rose an average 6.47 percent across the board in October from the previous month, state-owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said in a report released Thursday.
Light Isthmus crude sold at an average $22.86 per barrel for the month, up 4.48 percent from the previous month, Pemex said.
Heavy Maya crude prices rose 6.53 percent in October from the month before to an average $20.57 per barrel, while extra-light Olmeca crude rose 5.64 percent to $24.74 per barrel.
Average October crude exports to the Americas sold at $22.53 per barrel, to Europe at $19.32 per barrel and to the Far East $22.49 per barrel.
